causeAnalysis.method: Same-day fast/slow pair on 09-03, ~7h apart: run 33745159758 (10:39, webRunTests 86s) vs run 33785884076 (17:45, webRunTests 163s).
causeAnalysis.finding: The wall-clock 'run tests' step grew 90% (86s -> 163s) while the summed top-10 slowest-file durations grew only 23% (126.2s -> 155.5s). The slowdown is also non-uniform: write-heavy files inflated (score-comparison-analytics 16.07 -> 33.89, traces-api 13.81 -> 21.58, datasets-api 8.26 -> 14.73, ingestion-api 13.96 -> 17.31) while read/query-heavy files got FASTER (event-repository 21.53 -> 15.89, queryBuilder 13.56 -> 8.62).
causeAnalysis.interpretation: Wall time growing 4x faster than test-execution time means the extra seconds sit in scheduling and I/O stalls, not in test bodies. The split between inflated write-heavy and unaffected read-heavy files points at the containerised Postgres/ClickHouse services being write-slow under host I/O pressure. This is host/runner capacity variance, not a code regression.
causeAnalysis.secondaryContributor: Worker suite grew from 174 files / 2308 tests (09-01) to 177 files / 2345 tests (09-04), +1.6% tests in three days. Real but far too small to account for +21%.
causeAnalysis.confidence: medium-high on 'not a code regression' (no single job regressed day-over-day; per-job medians stable; within-day spread on 09-01 alone ranges 184s-314s perceived). Lower confidence on the precise host mechanism, which is not observable from the API.

flakyTests.test: web/src/__tests__/server/admin-api-keys.servertest.ts > Admin API keys route > invalidates all cached API keys without deleting other redis entries
flakyTests.status: NEW this week, already recurring across two different events
flakyTests.rootCause: The test asserts an exact invalidatedCount of 2 against a shared Redis database while the handler's invalidate-all scans every api-key:* key globally. Any concurrently-running shard or leftover entry that holds an API-key cache key makes the observed count 3+, and the assertion fails. Widening parallelism widens the collision window.
flakyTests.fixShape: Stop asserting an exact global count. Either assert invalidatedCount >= 2, or scope the assertion to the two keys the test itself created (the surrounding per-key assertions on lines 84-88 already cover the real behaviour). Not proposed as a diff this run because it is not verifiable in-sandbox (needs Redis).
